topic: MRI in inflammatory arthritis: bone marrow oedema, erosions, tenosynovitis scoring

source.title: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)-Based Semi-Quantitative Methods for Rheumatoid Arthritis: From Scoring to Measurement
source.whyItFits: Open review that states what the original RAMRIS scores, what the update added, and the 0–3 and 0–10 scales for synovitis, bone-marrow oedema, erosions, and tenosynovitis. The short OMERACT atlas record was not used.
